notes: One consolidated register, both companies. This supersedes REG/DCTS/2026-1014 R1, which separated the two companies. The money is the same; it is set out here in a single date order with the receiving company shown against each line — DCTS for Doha Cooling Trading & Solutions W.L.L. and TNDK for The New Doha Kitchen Equipment Services W.L.L.

Every instrument is fully evidenced — eleven cheques and six transfers, each carrying its number or reference, the drawer's account, the bank and the date, and each producible to a client, an auditor or a bank on demand.

Cash is not in this register. Oriental Agro paid a further QAR 375,000.00 in cash against nine vouchers, Samoosa Shop settled QAR 38,500.00 in cash, and TNDK took QAR 2,450.00 in cash from Al Noor Bakery, BSI and Lean N Fit. Those sit in the cash records.
Receipts. Eight of the seventeen instruments were taken without a receipt leaving the office; those lines carry 'not issued' in the Vch No. column and can now be raised, the instruments being known.
Internal record — compiled from the cheques, transfer advices and vouchers held, as at the date shown above.
